name: xyz.universalgoods.api.shopping.dpp
title: Digital Product Passport links
description: Adds a `dpp` object to catalog variants: where the product's Digital Product Passport is published and where its integrity can be checked. It carries links and the record's level of detail only. It never states the outcome of a check: the same fields appear, with the same shape, whether or not the passport's data is signed and recorded on chain. To learn that, GET `verification_url`.

dpp.description: Digital Product Passport links for this variant. Absent when the variant has no passport.

upi.description: The unique product identifier: a GS1 Digital Link URI, https://{host}/01/{gtin}, with /10/{lot} or /21/{serial} for a batch- or item-level passport. It is the address printed in the product's QR code. Dereferencing it returns the passport (JSON for a machine, a page for a browser).

passport_url.description: The public passport as JSON, at the issuing platform's API. Same document the UPI serves to a non-browser client; stable even where the UPI host only answers GS1 paths.

verification_url.description: GET it for a verdict on this passport: whether its data was signed by the issuer and recorded on chain, and whether it has changed since. No authentication, no parameters. This is the same URL the passport itself advertises as links.verificationUrl.

granularity.description: The level of detail the passport describes: model (the product type, one record per GTIN), batch (one production lot) or item (one individual unit). A description of the record, not the result of a check.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.title: Catalog Search with Digital Product Passport links
